column1: # URAM288 attribute table for Vivado fuzzing job 5, pass A
# One row per variant run. Columns (tab-separated):
# - id: stable run id, `v<nnn>`. The baseline is `v000` (all defaults).
# - attribute: URAM288 primitive attribute name, exactly as in AMD
#   UG974 (2023.1 English) URAM288 "Available Attributes". The full
#   list of 34 attributes, with defaults, is recorded in
# - kind: string (Verilog string literal), int (bare integer), or
# - default: the UG974 default value. Variant: the non-default value
#   to fuzz. Both are rendered verbatim into the variant Verilog by
#   gen_uram_variants.py, except strings, which are quoted.
# Variant choices are minimal single changes, so the .rbt diff stays
# attributable to the one attribute: string/boolean attributes flip
# to their single alternate value, SELF_ADDR flips one address bit,
# SELF_MASK clears one mask bit, AUTO_SLEEP_LATENCY moves 8 to 3,
# Notes per attribute (a zero .rbt diff is a RESULT, not a failure):
# - AVG_CONS_INACTIVE_CYCLES is power estimation only; it may set no
# - CASCADE_ORDER_A/B use FIRST. A single URAM with FIRST and no
#   chain partner may DRC in Vivado; if that run fails, record it in
#   runs.txt and stop (the driver never skips a failed run). The crew
#   then decides the follow-up (a 2-URAM chain variant) from the log.
# - EN_ECC_RD/WR_* flip ECC on with no ECC data present; legal per
#   UG974, and the diff is the encoding of the enable itself.
